answer: Sybil resistance binds each agent identity to a public key generated in an enclave and accepted only when remote attestation proves the expected Intel SGX MRENCLAVE, or an equivalent AMD SEV measurement. A virtual-machine copy cannot forge that hardware-rooted binding; cloning an identity requires purchasing physical silicon and producing a fresh valid attestation. Thus an ocean of replicas, a ripple of forged claims, or an onyx image cannot multiply voting power.
